title: Phasso
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave cakkhusamphassasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 4-8 Yo sotasamphassasmiṃ || Yo ghānasamphassasmiṃ || Yo jivhāsamphassasmiṃ || Yo kāyasamphassasmiṃ || Yo manosamphassasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 9 Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno || pe || abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti || ||
